rate_burst.description: The number of API requests a token may send at once before RateLimit applies.

rate_limit.description: The sustained number of API requests per second for each API token (browser sessions are limited per user). Excess requests get HTTP 429.

inventory.description: Configures inventory behavior (number format of generated inventory numbers).

number_format.description: The template of automatically assigned inventory numbers: {prefix} is the category prefix, {seq:05} the running number with the given minimum width. Without {prefix} (for example "{seq:04}" for 0001, 0002, …) all categories share one running number; a category without prefix drops {prefix} and the separator after it.

format.description: The log output format: text or json.

level.description: The minimum log level: debug, info, warn or error.

organization.description: Describes who runs this instance; it appears on printed inspection protocols.

name.description: Printed in the header of inspection protocols, for example the name of your association or company. Optional; empty prints no name.

public_url.description: The externally visible base URL (scheme, host and port, no path). If it starts with https://, session cookies are marked Secure. Requests whose Origin header differs from it are rejected.

secret_key_file.description: The file with the AES-256 key that encrypts secrets in the database (64 hex characters). It is created if missing.

path.description: The SQLite database file. Its directory is created if missing.

tls.description: Enables the built-in TLS listener; usually a reverse proxy does this.

cert_file.description: The PEM certificate (chain). Set together with tls.key_file.

trusted_proxies.description: The proxy IPs or networks whose X-Real-IP / X-Forwarded-For headers are trusted for client IPs (lockout, audit log).
